subject.title: fix(xai): respect ssrfPolicy and request.allowPrivateNetwork in image_generate

question: Should xAI image generation treat both browser.ssrfPolicy private-network opt-in and the sanitized models.providers.xai.request.allowPrivateNetwork setting as authorization to contact private endpoints?
rationale: The code can implement either policy safely, but choosing which existing settings authorize this security-sensitive provider surface is a maintainer-owned trust-boundary decision.

options.title: Approve both existing opt-ins
options.body: Keep the current shared configured-request implementation so global SSRF policy or the xAI provider request setting can explicitly authorize private endpoints.

options.title: Restrict the authorization source
options.body: Narrow the patch to the maintainer-selected policy source and add tests and documentation establishing why the other setting does not apply to xAI image generation.

recommendation.title: Approve both existing opt-ins
recommendation.body: Keep the current shared configured-request implementation so global SSRF policy or the xAI provider request setting can explicitly authorize private endpoints.

likelyOwner.reason: This person most recently handled the adjacent merged private-network SSRF policy decision for a bundled image provider.
